source_audio.note: Read-only 16 kHz mono from the same resampler as Exp001. Exp001 scores were not read.

embedding_model.normalization: L2 after encode_batch(..., normalize=False), matching verify_batch cosine.

vad.confidence_note: Silero's segment API does not return a per-region confidence.

params.match_rule: Assign the window to the existing prototype with the highest cosine if that cosine is >= match_cosine. Otherwise open a new cluster and mark the window NOVEL. The prototype is the L2-normalized sum of embeddings already assigned to the cluster, excluding this window.
params.recurring_rule: Before the current window is added, a cluster is RECURRING when it has at least 3 appearances, last_seen - first_seen is at least 60s, and attributed speech is at least 6s. The current window cannot make itself recurring.
params.appearance_rule: occurrence_count starts at 1. It increments when window_start - previous last_seen is greater than 10s.
params.cumulative_speech_rule: Attributed speech adds only newly covered seconds. A later overlapping window of the same cluster does not count the shared span twice.
params.continuity_score: Mean, over embedding windows with window_end in (t-15s, t], of speaker_is_recurring multiplied by cosine similarity to the best existing prototype. Null when no embedding window completed in that span. Silence is not in the denominator.
params.return_score: On a window that matches a cluster already RECURRING, with window_start - last_seen >= 30s: similarity * strength * absence_factor. strength = min(1, cumulative_speech/30) * min(1, occurrence_count/5), using the cluster state before this window. absence_factor = min(1, absence/60). Otherwise 0. The timeline second keeps the max of windows that ended during it.
params.fraction_denominator: Trailing fractions use embedding windows whose window_end lies in (t-W, t]. Seconds with no completed window are omitted, so crowd noise and silence do not count as lost speakers.
params.turnover_rate_30s: Number of assigned-cluster changes between successive embedding windows that ended inside (t-30s, t]. A count per trailing 30s, not a per-second rate.
params.vad_lookahead: Silero confirms a speech end after 100ms of silence and pads 30ms. That hangover is internal to the segmenter. Cluster memory never sees a window that has not ended.
